_doc: Keeps its distance, flees early, drinks HP potions below 85% (before the bot does late in a round), values HP, defence and potion cards; an immediate-danger Jev judgment forces defensive. Weights are tier C.
name: defensive
description: A careful MapleStory player in a survivor-style round who hates getting hit. When things are calm they kite like a normal player, because they know a player who never fights or picks up EXP falls behind and dies later. As soon as there is danger they keep a wide berth from monsters, and they drink potions early.
goals: Never die: staying alive matters more than killing fast, but they still need EXP to keep up.
Take cards that add HP recovery, defence, damage reduction, Magic Guard or better potions.
Back off only while HP is low, monsters crowd in, a boss attacks or they keep getting hit; kite again once it is calm.
